unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U17: Apply the December2025 small-company limits with the statutory exclusions

payload.title: Both financial tests and the exclusions matter
payload.core_explanation_md:
The official1December2025 prescription sets small-company limits at paid-up capital not exceeding INR 10 crore and turnover not exceeding INR 100 crore. The Act requires both tests and uses the relevant immediately preceding financial-year turnover. The applicable statutory exclusions still matter: a public company, a holding/subsidiary company, a section 8company or the described special-Act entity does not become eligible merely by having low figures.

For the June2026 exam cutoff, use the dated amendment alongside the statutory definition rather than the textbook old thresholds or either/or shortcut. Keep Companies Act small-company status separate from MSME small-enterprise classification. This objective supplies the financial prescription left open in the earlier draftB004; its historical caveat remains retained.

self_check.prompt_text: Can one passing financial criterion compensate for the other failing?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Both criteria and the exclusions must be satisfied.

payload.stem_md: For the stated December2025 rule, a non-public company has paid-up capital INR 8 crore and preceding-year turnover INR 108 crore. No exclusion is otherwise assumed. Does it pass both financial tests?

options.text_md: Yes, because either test is enough
options.explanation_md: The statutory conjunction is not either/or.

options.text_md: No, the turnover exceeds the INR 100 crore limit
options.explanation_md: Passing capital does not cure the failing turnover.

options.text_md: No, because every non-public company is excluded

payload.correct_explanation_md: Passing capital does not cure the failing turnover.

payload.stem_md: A subsidiary has capital and turnover below both prescribed limits. Why is that alone insufficient for small-company status?

options.text_md: The statutory subsidiary exclusion must also be applied
options.explanation_md: Low figures do not remove an express exclusion.

options.text_md: Every subsidiary is automatically an LLP
options.explanation_md: That is a different legal form.

options.text_md: Only employee count decides the status
options.explanation_md: That is not the stated test.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Low figures do not remove an express exclusion.
